steps.headline: Your mind scans every moment.
steps.body: Most of it goes unnoticed. Emomapp makes it visible and creates your reality trajectory.

steps.headline: Two questions. Ten seconds.
steps.body: How is life treating you right now? How are YOU moving through it? Your answers are coordinates on a map. Check in often — and the map becomes a trail.

steps.headline: Emomapp will track your inner world.
steps.body: After enough check-ins, you will see your unique patterns. Where do you tend to land? What moves you? An AI reads your trail and reflects it back.

steps.headline: Your first report in 5 check-ins.
steps.body: After two weeks of regular check-ins — a detailed analysis of your unique patterns. The more you check in, the clearer the picture.

Building.description: The circumstances are helping, and you're actively shaping what's happening. You're directing, creating, moving something forward.
Building.question: Does anything here no longer need your effort?

Protecting.description: The circumstances are pressing, and you're actively holding your ground — resisting, confronting, managing what's coming.
Protecting.question: What here truly needs your protection right now?

Receiving.description: The circumstances are supportive, and you're allowing yourself to take that in. You're not directing — you're open and receiving.
Receiving.question: What becomes possible now that you feel supported?

Enduring.description: The circumstances are pressing, and your ability to change them right now is limited. You're moving through what you can't yet change.
Enduring.question: What is one small part of this moment still within your reach?

Opening.description: You're ready to act, though the circumstances aren't fully clear yet. Direction is still taking shape.
Opening.question: What could you learn before choosing a direction?

Bracing.description: The circumstances feel pressing, but the way to respond isn't clear yet. You're reading the situation and preparing.
Bracing.question: What is happening now — and what are you only preparing for?

Seeking.description: The circumstances seem favorable, but your role isn't fully clear yet. You're looking at what's available.
Seeking.question: What are you looking for — and what is already here?

Drifting.description: The circumstances are unclear, and you're not trying to direct them. You're watching and waiting for something to emerge.
Drifting.question: What can you notice or choose without full clarity?

Still.description: Neither the circumstances nor your role have a clear direction right now. This is a pause where much is still undefined.
Still.question: What kind of stillness is this for you?

under5.headline: Good.
under5.subtext: Come back when something shifts. Each check-in adds a point to your map — you need 5 to see your first patterns.

midRange.headline: Logged.
midRange.subtext: Come back when something shifts. The more moments you capture, the clearer the picture becomes. Your full report unlocks at 20 check-ins.

full.headline: Logged.
full.subtext: Every check-in makes your self-portrait sharper. The pattern keeps forming.

Notifications.body:
People who notice meaningful patterns check in whenever something shifts — a conversation, a change of mood, a moment worth remembering.



Turn on reminders and we'll nudge you to check in.
